newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil boosted by run cuts.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil boosted by run cuts.

text.p: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil markets were steady to firmer on Tuesday, underpinned by news of more crude oil run cuts at European refineries, traders said.

An ARA player was heard offering March barrels at $125/$126 fob NWE. This talk follows deals out of northern Spain heard to have been concluded on Friday at around $122 fob NWE for material containing around one percent sulphur.
A French refiner was heard to have cut crude oil throughputs and to have bought two low sulphur straight-run cargoes as an alternative feedstock.
